news.text: #Juventus, at the moment, is working to try to get #Vicario with the formula of a loan with an option to buy 🧤⚪️⚫️[Romeo Agresti]

#Tottenham has opened to the loan of #Vicario and #Juventus is convinced to proceed rapidly to bring him to Turin. This is also because #AstonVilla showed no openness to meet the bianconeri's demands in the negotiation for #DibuMartinez: the decision to leave the table is the result of an exclusively economic evaluation. #Carnevali's intervention was to define everything by Monday (today) and so it will be. All details on @Gazzetta_it. #calciomercato[Giovanni Albanese]
#Vicario-@JuventusFC: contacts ongoing with the @SpursOfficial on the basis of a loan with an option to buy. They are looking to close as soon as possible. @SkySport[Di Marzio]

🚨⚪️⚫️ Juventus and Dibu Martínez camp had direct talk tonight: deal officially off. ❌Difference on price asked by Aston Villa was considered too high, Juventus are proceeding on Vicario deal.[Fabrizio Romano]

Juventus have always been cautious on proceeding with Emi Martinez due to his finger injury, as reported this morning. Deal not proceeding as it stands. Guglielmo Vicario a viable option for Juventus.Zion Suzuki will still join Aston Villa even if Martinez stays.🧤[Ben Jacobs]

🚨🧤 Juventus, Aston Villa and Emiliano Martínez camp all calling the deal 100% off tonight.There were huge differences on price and also Juve doubtful on finger issue.#AVFC still sign Suzuki and Juventus now in direct talks for Guglielmo Vicario. 🔜[Fabrizio Romano]

🚨🟣🔵 Aston Villa are still proceeding with all the formal steps of Zion Suzuki deal even after Emi Martínez to Juventus stopped.#AVFC booked medical for Suzuki and all set to proceed early next week for Japan goalkeeper. 🇯🇵[Fabrizio Romano]

🚨⚪️⚫️ Juventus have made official club to club approach with Tottenham for Guglielmo Vicario after Martínez deal currently off.Vicario wants Juventus and clubs now in direct negotiations on loan with buy clause.Talks underway to get it done. 🇮🇹[Fabrizio Romano]

🚨🇦🇷 Juventus and Aston Villa are still far away from club to club agreement for Emiliano Martínez, as of tonight.Villa insist on €15m valuation while Juve believe €6m plus add-ons proposal was fair.Deal currently not proceeding.[Fabrizio Romano]

🚨 Emiliano Martinez from Aston Villa to Juventus off. Talks reduced price gap & personal terms for 33yo goalkeeper no issue but #Juve not proceeding on deal. #AVFC will try to find solution but either way Zion Suzuki new No1. W/ @J_Tanswell @TheAthleticFC[David Ornstein]
#DibuMartinez 📉📉📉[Romeo Agresti]

GJustjuve Exclusive: #Juventus, agreement in principle with #Tottenham for Guglielmo #Vicario. Parties very close. Possible closure tomorrow. @sportmediaset [Orazio Accomando] https://t.me/GJustjuve/71298+++#Juventus, #Vicario will arrive on loan with an obligation to buy. There was an acceleration in the last few hours for the #Tottenham goalkeeper. Tomorrow the deal will be closed.+++@sportmediaset[Orazio Accomando]

🇦🇷❓"If the medical approval on Emiliano #Martínez arrives, #Juventus is ready to offer €6/7M + bonuses, but without reaching €15M. #AstonVilla, on the other hand, continues to ask €15/16M, so there is a gap. Furthermore, the bianconeri do not yet have certainty regarding the recovery times for the finger problem and want to have everything 100% clear before making an investment in him."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹🧐 "#Juventus called #Tottenham for #Vicario to understand if he can be taken on loan. For the moment, they would evaluate the player only under this formula. Moreover, his agent is the same agent who worked on the #Lucumí deal. Today he was in Turin precisely to talk about the Colombian, but naturally, one wonders if there was also a discussion about the goalkeeper."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
